title: Department of Computer Science & Engineering and CSE (AI & ML)
content:
The Department of Computer Science and Engineering was established in 2001 and offers B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering. According to the official department page, core areas include software engineering, computer networks and security, soft computing, RDBMS, and operating systems. The department started M.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering in 2004.

CSE (AI & ML) was established in 2022 and offers a Bachelor programme in Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning. The official page notes AICTE accreditation for the CSE AI & ML programme and states approximately 120 full-time undergraduates pursue CSE AI & ML.

Published intake (Engineering admissions page): B.Tech CSE Direct 180 / Lateral 12; B.Tech CSE (AI & ML) Direct 180 / Lateral 6; M.Tech CSE (AI & ML) intake 18.

Department vision (published): to be a global leader in Computer Science and Engineering, advancing AI and ML through research, education, and ethical applications.

title: Engineering Departments and Programmes
content:
DAVIET engineering-related undergraduate departments/programmes published on the official site include:
- Computer Science & Engineering
- Computer Science & Engineering (AI & ML)
- Electronics & Communication Engineering
- Electrical Engineering
- Mechanical Engineering
- Civil Engineering
- Applied Sciences (supports foundation sciences for engineering programmes)

Post-graduate engineering programmes listed include M.Tech CSE (AI & ML) and M.Tech Civil Engineering (Structural Engineering).

Other academic units listed in site navigation: Computer Applications, Business Management / MBA, Hospitality & Tourism Management.

For department-specific faculty lists, labs, and notices, open the respective department page on davietjal.org.
